name: Rapid movement offshore or to crypto after receipt
description: Incoming funds are quickly sent abroad or converted to virtual assets soon after being credited.
fp: Genuine international payments or planned crypto purchases by established customers.

links.name: Business account receives funds then moves them offshore or to crypto quickly
links.ctx: Mule-side: a recipient account (often newly opened or a shell) forwards BEC proceeds within hours.

links.name: Rapid movement offshore or to crypto after receipt
links.ctx: Scam proceeds leave rapidly to offshore accounts or are converted to virtual assets within hours of credit, the cash-out end of the chain.

links.name: International transfers or cryptocurrency purchases following credits
links.ctx: Funds exit via overseas transfers, gift cards or crypto purchases after receipt.
links.fp: International students and migrants send money abroad.

links.name: Rapid movement offshore or to crypto after receipt
links.ctx: Sale proceeds from a spike in price are moved offshore or into virtual assets within days, before the price retraces or a regulator or venue intervenes.
